quote: Prove that the MSG distribution complies with the ordering with the highest likelihood (the likelihood ratio ordering). Assume that X and Y are two independent Random variables with probability distribution function fX(x; λ, θ) and fY(x; β, α). If λ < α and θ < β, then Λ = fX(x;λ,θ)/fY(x;β,α) = [θ²/(λ+1)(λθ/2 x² + (θ+x)/(θ²+1)) e^{−θx}] / [α²/(β+1)(βα/2 x² + (α+x)/(α²+1)) e^{−αx}] ... Hence, ∂log[Λ]/∂x < 0 if λ < β, θ < α.
family: MGS/MGSD (mixture of Gamma(3,θ) and Shanker(θ)): f(x;λ,θ) = θ²/(λ+1)(λθx²/2 + (θ+x)/(θ²+1))e^{−θx}, x > 0
compared: X ~ MGS(λ, θ) vs Y ~ MGS(β, α)
